limitations: Analytic dispatch counts and instrumented timings are not hardware FLOP counters or benchmark latency.
Only observed recipe/seed/input/control flow; no full NVIDIA kernel coverage claim.
Legacy event.kernels labels are excluded: they can be CPU operator names.
Hooks/shape capture/dispatch tracing change allocation and scheduling; perturbation is not quantified.
Owned inference worker only; parent model/hook/device/RNG/allocator handles never transferred.
CUDA Event elapsed intervals are inclusive instrumented stream intervals, not kernel attribution or benchmark latency.
CUDA Event objects are worker-local; exported evidence validates pairing/conversion, not independent replay of the GPU clock.
B4 native failure UNRESOLVED; risk OPEN.

measurements.comparisons_scope: comparisons_per_batch is supported subtotal; total requires complete coverage

coverage.basis: observed_ATen_call_count; not fraction of FLOPs or kernels

measurements.flop_scope: ordinary_arithmetic_only; special operation counts are not FLOP-equivalent

convention.flops: add/subtract/multiply/divide only; FMA=2; comparisons, roots and transcendentals separate
convention.memory_layout_copy_cast: zero arithmetic FLOPs; memory cost not counted
convention.nonlinear_normalization: unfused reference algebra; named special operations have no FLOP weight
convention.scalar_policy: dense reference evaluates alpha/beta scaling; no value-based runtime shortcut inference
convention.scope: observed dispatch calls; dense logical work, not hardware instructions
convention.transposed_convolution: valid input-kernel-output contributions; clipped scatter, FMA=2
